evaluator_contract_checks.column_label_finding_basis: score_prediction checks len(pred.columns) and len(gold.columns), then calls rows_equal; it contains no pred.columns == gold.columns or metadata-name comparison.

query_blinding: Mutation constructors are fixed by the GridDB schema and base rows; they do not read gold SQL, questions, predictions, scores, or correctness when constructing states.
scope: independent design diagnostic; not the formal experiment and not claim-promoting evidence
